name: an action

phase_0.boundary_condition: The stationary path in configuration space where the variation of the action integral equals zero

VINIT.justification: The absence of path or manifold before coordinates are defined

TANCH.justification: The fixed endpoints in time and space that contain the variational problem

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation along the trajectory toward the final state

AREV.justification: The contravariant transformation back to the initial conditions

CLINK.justification: The sequential composition of infinitesimal segments into a global trajectory

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-recognition of the system state that remains invariant under transformation

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of a single trajectory into competing virtual paths for extremization

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of virtual paths into the unique physical path that minimizes action

EVALT.justification: Success state where the path variation satisfies the Euler-Lagrange equations

EVALF.justification: Failure state where the path does not satisfy the principle of least action

ENGAGR.justification: A state where multiple paths are held in quantum probability before observation collapses the action

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of the actualized path through phase space

phase_3.void_description: pre-measurement vacuum state without defined degrees of freedom
phase_3.true_description: actualized physical trajectory minimizing the action functional
phase_3.false_description: suppressed virtual path that violates the principle of least action
phase_3.both_description: coherent path integral state where all possible histories contribute to the probability amplitude

steps.domain_action: Define the initial vacuum state before coordinate assignment
Fix the initial and final position and time boundary set
Construct the Lagrangian map relating kinetic and potential energy
Identify the symmetry group acting on the coordinate manifold
Generate the ensemble of virtual trajectories between boundary points
Identify the unique path yielding a stationary action integral
Identify and suppress the infinite set of non-stationary paths
Collapse the variational ensemble back into the physical path X
Propagate the system state along the physical trajectory
Hold the duality between wave and particle descriptions during transit
Map the conjugate momenta through time reversal for consistency check
Permanently log the observable result as a point in the time-series record
Enforce the final terminal boundary condition to seal the action

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Euler-Lagrange equations translating energy relations into motion
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Variational calculus signals connecting adjacent manifold segments
phase_5.memory_mechanism: State vector in phase space capturing position and momentum
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Hamiltonian flow determining the time evolution of the system
phase_5.alfs_store: The fundamental physical constants and metric signature of the manifold

phase_6.cycle_cost: Potential energy converted into kinetic energy and heat
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Initial potential energy configuration at time zero
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Final kinetic and dissipated energy state at terminal time
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The least action principle describes a reversible adiabatic process in a closed conservative system
